snippet.title: FUTURE? NO THANKS! - Announcement Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Slightly outdated trailer, check Steam for newer versions.

Future? No Thanks! is a narrative-driven, open-world adventure set in an ecosocialist utopia. The year is 2045, and society has never been better: climate change is finally being tackled, democracy thrives, and technology serves humanity rather than enslaving it.

There's just one problem: you.

You are Harvey Huffstone, a grumpy elder who no longer fits in, and today is the last day of your life. Your final mission? Completing your bucket list before your self-scheduled euthanasia. 
Indulge in outdated pleasures, explore a post-post-industrial Midwest, clash with a society that's moved on without you, and maybe, just maybe, leave with fewer regrets.

futurenothanks.com

About us:
Since 2003, Molleindustria has produced artisanal remedies to the idiocy of mainstream entertainment in the form of free, short-form, online games. Our titles range from satirical business simulations (McDonald's Video Game, Oiligarchy) to meditations on labor and alienation (Every Day the Same Dream, Phone Story, Unmanned), and timely interventions on contemporary politics and culture (Democratic Socialism Simulator, The New York Times Simulator).
Future? No Thanks! has been in the works for over 5 years and is the biggest Molleindustria project to date.

Trailer music: Wasted On Youth by The Gotobeds
